## Constraints & Preferences
- Established IVX Holdings Expo/React Native project — NOT new project, NOT Swift
- Owner demands honest evidence-only reports — no narrative, no punting, no percentages, no "almost done", no "should work"
- Final verdict must be exactly "END-TO-END COMPLETE" or "NOT END-TO-END COMPLETE" with blockers listed
- No test disabling, no blanket skip, no reduced coverage, no swallowing errors, no admin bypass, no unrelated refactor
- Smallest correct production-safe change with regression tests
- Execute items in order, do not move to next until current is VERIFIED COMPLETE or BLOCKED WITH EXACT RUNTIME EVIDENCE
- Start any task immediately — no planning detours, execute right away
- Anti-hallucination — never fabricate commits, SHAs, deployments, test results. Use "UNVERIFIED" when evidence unavailable
- STOP asking for GitHub credentials — token `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` works
- Render API key: `rnd_1H0XCquMZQTRyAnHgbEv8dVWYPVs` — service ID `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`
- Use `bun` not `npx`/`npm`
- Project root: `/home/user/rork-app/expo/`

- **Restarted Supabase project**: Backend endpoints touching Supabase Auth/Postgres were timing out from both Render and sandbox; restart resolved this — project is now `ACTIVE_HEALTHY` and endpoints respond
- **Added `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`** to Render env vars — the backend's `getSupabaseAdmin()` was falling back to anon key because service role key was missing
- **v1.10.4 is a revert to the working Instagram technique** but keeps all v1.10.2 hardening (state machine, trace IDs, per-stage timeouts, recovery hardening)
